aquatic: Aquatic plants, life, systems, etc. live in or are related to water.
The number of aquatic plants in the river has dropped.
aquarius: Aquarius is a constellation of the zodiac supposedly shaped like like a water carrier.
Aquarius is the zodiac sign for the water carrier. It is from January 20 – February 18 (tropical astrology) or February 15 – March 14 (sidereal astrology)..
aquaphobia: Aquaphobia is the fear or dislike of water or drowning
aquarium: An aquarium is a place where fish and other animals that live in water are kept to be looked at.
My favourite animals in the aquarium were the sharks and dolphins.
aqueduct: An aqueduct is an artificial channel that is constructed to transport water between locations.
aqueous: Something that is aqueous is related to water.
Something that is aqueous contains mostly of water.
aquaplane: If a car aquaplanes, it loses traction with the road due to the vehicle's tyres on a film of water on the road.
